title: DataTalksClub AI Dev Tools Zoomcamp 2026 — Project Rubric

version_history.note: Initial frozen 12-criterion / 24-point official rubric (10 to pass). Immutable: updates create a new versioned row via rubric_service.resolve_immutable_version (patch bump, e.g. 2026.1.0 -> 2026.1.1); existing DB seed rows are never mutated.

criteria.name: Problem Description
criteria.description: Clarity and depth of the problem description and how the system addresses it.

scoring_levels.description: Problem description is missing or vague.
Problem is described, but the target audience, motivation, or how the application solves it is unclear.
Problem is clearly and thoroughly described, explaining who has the problem, why existing approaches fall short, and how the project solves it.

criteria.name: Product Specification
criteria.description: Structured product specification guiding the system's design and implementation.

scoring_levels.description: No product specification provided.
Basic product specification exists but lacks functional requirements, architecture details, or acceptance criteria.
Comprehensive product specification maintained in the repository covering features, architecture, data model, security, and acceptance criteria.

criteria.name: Agent Team Specification
criteria.description: Definition of specialized AI agents, roles, boundaries, and coordination protocols.

scoring_levels.description: No agent team specification or specialized agent roles defined.
Agents are defined informally without clear role boundaries, structured outputs, or coordination rules.
Explicit agent team specification defining specialized development and runtime agents, their responsibilities, file ownership, tools, and structured schemas.

criteria.name: Context Management
criteria.description: Use of hierarchical rules (AGENTS.md), modular skills, and progressive disclosure.

scoring_levels.description: No context management files (AGENTS.md, skills, or project rules) in the repository.
Single monolithic instructions file without scoped rules or reusable skills.
Structured context management using hierarchical AGENTS.md files and modular, on-demand skills (.agents/skills/) kept in sync with the codebase.

criteria.name: Application
criteria.description: End-to-end functionality of frontend, backend, and persistent database storage.

scoring_levels.description: No working application, or a missing frontend, backend or persistent storage.
Frontend, backend and database exist but are not fully connected.
Full-stack application works end-to-end and runs locally with a single command.

criteria.name: Testing
criteria.description: Automated unit, integration, and end-to-end test suite coverage.

scoring_levels.description: No automated tests exist in the repository.
Only basic unit tests exist for isolated functions without integration or E2E coverage.
Comprehensive automated tests covering backend unit/integration tests (Pytest) and frontend/end-to-end tests (Playwright/Vitest), runnable via a single command.

criteria.name: Containerization
criteria.description: Dockerization of all application services and multi-container orchestration.

scoring_levels.description: Application is not containerized.
Dockerfile exists for part of the app, but full stack cannot be started with Docker Compose.
All services (frontend, backend, worker, database, reverse proxy) are containerized and orchestrated with Docker Compose.

criteria.name: Deployment
criteria.description: Live cloud/VPS deployment accessible over HTTPS.

scoring_levels.description: Application is not deployed to a remote environment.
Deployment configuration or instructions exist, or deployment is only accessible over plain HTTP / unstable.
Application is deployed on a live server/cloud environment with HTTPS, health checks, and documented reviewer access.

criteria.name: CI/CD
criteria.description: Continuous Integration testing and Continuous Deployment pipeline.

scoring_levels.description: No CI/CD pipeline.
CI automatically runs tests on every pull request.
CI runs tests and CD deploys automatically.
CI runs tests, CD deploys to development, and production deployment is manual.

criteria.name: Observability
criteria.description: Telemetry instrumentation (metrics, structured logs, traces) and dashboards.

scoring_levels.description: No observability or telemetry instrumentation.
Basic application logging or health endpoint without structured metrics, distributed tracing, or dashboards.
Full OpenTelemetry instrumentation exporting metrics (Prometheus), logs (Loki), and traces (Tempo) visualized in Grafana dashboards.

criteria.name: Alerting on User Impact
criteria.description: Actionable alerting rules triggered by user-facing SLIs/error rates or latency spikes.

scoring_levels.description: No alerting configured, or alerts only track low-level host CPU without user impact correlation.
Actionable alerts configured on user-impacting symptoms (HTTP 5xx error rate, high p95 latency, failed analysis jobs, or endpoint downtime).

criteria.name: On-Call Agent
criteria.description: Bounded, read-only AI on-call agent capable of diagnosing incidents from telemetry and logs.

scoring_levels.description: No on-call diagnostic agent implemented.
Basic log summarizer without structured incident diagnosis, telemetry querying, or strict read-only safety boundaries.
Bounded read-only on-call agent integrated with metrics/logs/traces and runbooks that diagnoses alerts, cites evidence, and proposes safe remediation steps.
